result.summary: Adds a new listrawtransactions wallet RPC that returns every wallet transaction exactly once with its net balance change and optional fee, without the economic-category interpretation that listtransactions applies. It supports count/skip pagination and a verbose flag to include a decoded transaction. The change extracts shared amount/fee and decoded-transaction helpers out of gettransaction for reuse, and adds a functional test and release notes.
result.problem: listtransactions only shows transactions with an assigned economic category (send/receive), so consolidations and pure self-transfers are invisible to users inspecting their wallet history, as reported in issue #34632. A prior attempt (#35009) to patch listtransactions itself was rejected in favor of a dedicated RPC.

resolved_concerns: Bicaru20's suggestion to dedupe listtransactions/listrawtransactions via a shared helper — author declined, explaining the two RPCs have fundamentally different per-output vs per-tx semantics.
achow101's request for a verbose/decoded field and RPC::Arg/snake_case naming — implemented.
w0xlt's bug report that count=0 incorrectly returned one entry — fixed to return an empty list.

polespinasa's request to avoid documenting an unreachable parent_descs field and to dedupe gettransaction/listrawtransactions logic via PushTxAmountAndFee/PushTxDecoded helpers — implemented as prep commits.
polespinasa's nit on move-iterator to avoid a copy — applied in the final push.

result.card: This PR adds a new listrawtransactions wallet RPC that lists every wallet transaction exactly once with its net balance change, exposing consolidations and self-transfers that the existing listtransactions RPC hides due to its category-based filtering. It closes issue #34632 and follows a prior closed attempt (#35009) that patched listtransactions directly before achow101 suggested a separate RPC instead. The PR underwent extensive review across many rounds (naming, dedup helpers, verbose flag, a count=0 bug, unreachable parent_descs field) and now carries multiple substantive ACKs including a fresh one on the final commit from polespinasa, with no open objections. It currently needs a rebase (dirty mergeable state, 'Needs rebase' label) before it can be merged, but the code and design are otherwise settled. It is a moderate, non-critical wallet/RPC feature: no fund-safety or consensus impact, just improved visibility into wallet transaction history.
